description: This file defines and manages dispatch key sets for backend and autograd functionalities in PyTorch, including functions for retrieving, checking, and iterating over dispatch keys and their associated properties.

classes.name: DispatchKeySet
classes.description: A set representing dispatch keys used for backend and autograd operations, with iterator support for traversal.

methods.name: getRuntimeDispatchKeySet
methods.description: Returns the set of runtime dispatch keys associated with a given dispatch key.

methods.name: runtimeDispatchKeySetHas
methods.description: Checks if a runtime dispatch key set contains a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: getBackendKeySetFromAutograd
methods.description: Returns the set of backend keys associated with a specific autograd dispatch key.

methods.name: isIncludedInAlias
methods.description: Determines if a dispatch key is included in an alias set.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a DispatchKeySet to its string representation.
